description: Broad Bonkler proportions with low center of mass, short planted travel, and strong silhouette changes.

motionGrammar.idle: Low breathing compression and eye change with a planted base.
motionGrammar.directionalRun: Short powerful alternating steps; broad body remains inside the wide envelope.
motionGrammar.wave: Attached arm or equivalent broad appendage wave.
motionGrammar.jump: Heavy anticipation, short airborne phase, and stable landing.
motionGrammar.failed: Low-center collapse and recovery without impact marks.
motionGrammar.working: Compact mechanical or hand-focused effort in place.
motionGrammar.review: Body-locked inspection with a clear approving tilt.
motionGrammar.look: Natural aiming feature and head/body yaw carry direction without rotating the complete sprite.
